issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

id.description: The unique and required id of this instance.

defaultContentUrl.description: If present, the user will be redirected to this url instead of the idp login page.

userIdFormat.description: Which field of the IdpUser to use as the user id

defaultGroupId.description:
The default group to assign to users upon successful authentication.
Security leveled groups are not permitted.

idpWriteback.description: Returns whether we should write back to the Idp

idpGroupWriteback.description: Returns whether we should write back {@link UserGroup} updates to the Idp

idpType.description: Returns the identity provider for write-back (if enabled)

externalAppId.description:
The external authentication application ID that this IdpConfig is associated with.
This is used to identify the application in the IdP ex: okta app id.

allowedEmailDomains.description:
List of allowed email domains that users can have to be able to login.
The email domain is everything after the '@' in the email address.
If empty, then no email domain validation is done on user login.

trustedApplicationHosts.description: Applications that are trusted to redirect authenticated user(s)

relevantGroups.description: List of relevant groups for the cluster from the IDP. If empty, then no group filtering is done on user login.

authorizationEndPoint.description: Idp OIDC endpoint for authorize request

issuer.description: The principal that issued the id token

keysUrl.description: Url to download certificates from idp server

autoImportCertificates.description:
If true, then the certificates are automatically imported from the configured keysUrl every time during authentication.
Otherwise, the certificates are imported only once during the creation of the OidcIdpConfig, and must be
refreshed manually

idTokenSigningAlgorithms.description: Signing algorithms to generate id tokens

responseTypes.description: Response types (e.g. code, id_token etc.) supported by idp server

responseModes.description: Response modes(e.g. form_post, query, fragment) supported by idp server

defaultResponseMode.description: Default response mode (e.g. form_post, query, fragment) to contact idp server

scopes.description: Scopes (openid, profile, email etc.) supported by idp server

certificates.description: Certificates used to validate id tokens issued by idp server

clientSecret.description: For Authorization Code Flow. Client Secret used to authenticate with the idp server when access token endpoint

audiences.description: audiences that are trusted to accept id tokens

jitUserCreation.description: Enable Just In Time user creation

stateJwtExpiration.description: state JWT encoded expiration in minutes

tokenEndPointTimeout.description: Timeout, in seconds for accessing the token endpoint

idpUserNameSuffix.description: Idp name (e.g. '@microsoft') used as username suffix for all the users that belong to this identity provider.

cookieDuration.description: How long the cookie is valid for the user sessions with idp

ignoreGroupsClaim.description: Ignores processing user groups sent by IdP present in the token if set to true.

directLogin.description: If true, allows direct authentication using access tokens issued by an OIDC-compliant IDP.

idpGroupClaimDelimiter.description:
Delimiter to split the Idp Token group claim.
   If not empty, Idp Token group claim is sent as a string instead of default array.

discoveryUrl.description: The discovery URL used to import the OIDC configuration.

claimNames.description: The claim names that are present in the OIDC ID token.

title:
This type implements the authentication request and login and logout redirect endpoints for OpenID Connect
authentication flow.
name: Oidc
